first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The sky area beyond the outline of the sloping ground surface, appearing pale blue in frame 0 and bright white and light-colored in frame 33.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The light yellow-brown rough ground surface occupying most of the field of view, with clumps of short grass interspersed with bare soil.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: The environmental vegetation group composed of scattered low clump-like vegetation in the near-to-midground and silhouettes of distant trees.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: The relatively smooth brown road strip on the right side of the opening image and the slender light and dark traces extending along the strip-shaped area.
